title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.26334v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. translated_title: 面向视频扩散Transformer中2比特KV缓存量化的在线时序旋转
translated_abstract: 视频扩散Transformer在去噪步骤之间复用键值（KV）缓存，这在长视频生成中迅速成为瓶颈。我们发现对时间上相距较远的缓存向量进行量化会导致较大的数值范围和较高的量化误差，但KV缓存中时间上相近的视频token在每个通道上共享一种持续稳定的模式。这些模式在不同视频之间也各不相同，这促使我们采用针对每个视频独特缓存自适应调整的旋转方法。我们提出了时序旋转量化（TRQ），该方法在量化之前对缓存中时间相邻的帧进行旋转。对于每个由时间相邻缓存向量组成的块，TRQ拟合一个正交变换，将该块的各通道均值映射为一个在各通道上接近常数的向量。为了保持量化格式的轻量化，我们将该旋转参数化为一棵由2×2平面旋转构成的树，每个旋转仅用两比特存储，随后接一个固定的Hadamard变换。
tldr: 提出时序旋转量化（TRQ）方法，通过在线拟合正交旋转将KV缓存中时间相邻帧的各通道均值映射为近似常数，并以仅需两比特存储的平面旋转树实现轻量参数化，从而在视频扩散Transformer中实现2比特KV缓存量化。
en_tdlr: Proposes Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), which fits online orthogonal rotations to map temporally adjacent KV-cache frames' per-channel means to near-constant vectors, parameterized as lightweight 2-bit planar rotation trees, enabling 2-bit KV-cache quantization in video diffusion transformers.
